-- Scenario 73c: SAP removes DOWNTIMEHOURS, a column guarded L1 depends on (breaking change).
-- Expected guarded: after the sync, the guard alert finds BREAKING drift and suspends the L2 DT
-- before it refreshes again; users keep the last good snapshot. Unguarded: the DT refresh fails every minute
-- and its downstream DT gets no new data (observed: scheduled refreshes still SUCCEEDED, a manual one fails).
alter table {{DEMO_L0}}.PUBLISHER.MAINT_NOTIFICATION drop column DOWNTIMEHOURS;

insert into {{DEMO_DB}}.CONTROL.SCHEMA_CHANGE_LOG (SCENARIO, EVENT, GUARDRAIL, DETAIL, SOURCE)
values ('73c', 'SCENARIO_RUN', null, 'SAP removed column MAINT_NOTIFICATION.DOWNTIMEHOURS (used by L1 as DOWNTIME_HOURS)', 'PRESENTER');
